verdict.rationale: Docs and community both confirm mise activates per-directory tool versions and env vars automatically once shell activation is set up (mise-docs-53, mise-docs-68, mise-docs-5, mise-docs-7, mise-docs-62, mise-gh-1, mise-gh-3), with hierarchical config merging across parent directories (mise-docs-18/27) and real-world confirmation from users (mise-comm-2, mise-comm-8, mise-comm-11). missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark/timing of activation switching speed or edge-case failure reports beyond anecdotal praise.
